propositions: Multiple fixture setup sites rely on `_expire_sync_marker` + `_engine_run(..., "list")` to establish preconditions, but `ensure_fresh`'s best-effort contract silently swallows failures under CI load, leaving clones in an invalid state.

23 `_expire_sync_marker` call sites split into two categories: 8 load-bearing preconditions (where one clone must be behind and needs checked fetch+merge) and 15 where reconvergence through the production read path IS the test invariant.

The 8 Kind-P precondition sites at lines 378, 398, 460, 1236, 1325, 1333, 1476, 1580 must be converted from sync-by-side-effect to deterministic `_sync_from_origin` (checked git fetch + ff-only merge) with their downstream asserts marked SETUP.

The 15 Kind-R sites must be routed through a named helper `_reconverge_by_read_sync` that documents why the best-effort read path is deliberate (the read-side sync IS the behavior under test, not a precondition).
Tests pass under default env and under `REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off` for all converted precondition sites, proving that deterministic sync now lands where incidental sync previously failed silently.
